propositions: A single criterion's evidence run exhausting its budget causes the entire bounded recovery to fail and propagates LLMBudgetExhaustedError, discarding all gathered evidence instead of marking that criterion unverifiable.
RunawayToolLoopError and token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError raised during per-criterion evidence gathering propagate outward identically to budget exhaustion, aborting recovery prematurely.

The per-criterion evidence loop treats budget exhaustion as a fatal aggregate failure rather than a per-criterion safeguard violation, when evidence collection should be resilient to individual criterion failures.
Partial evidence from successful criteria is lost when any single criterion's evidence run fails, preventing the finalizer from rendering a verdict across remaining criteria.

Recovery should continue after a criterion's evidence run fails, delivering a content-free exhausted-bounds placeholder to the finalizer and only failing outright if all criteria exhaust their budgets.
